C0268.title: WeChat Enforcement Notice on Personal Accounts Promoting Prohibited Goods
C0268.summary: WeChat Security Center announced a crackdown on personal accounts posting marketing content for prohibited items, including tobacco, e-cigarettes, aphrodisiacs, and illicit health supplements. Since January 2023, a total of 7,236 accounts and 1,871 group chats have received graduated penalties such as feature restrictions or account bans for promoting prohibited goods.
